seating.notes: Fionnuala (left-handed) at the left end. Other top table seats are not yet assigned and need the client's list. accessibility: No quotes have been received or committed. I have no tools to contact vendors, so budget total_eur is a placeholder of 0 until written, VAT-inclusive itemised quotes arrive. The hard cap is EUR 18,500 incl. VAT.

Quotes to request, nothing committed: venue (including room flip, curfew, Long Gallery capacity for about 140 with heaters and coat handling, livestream AV and connectivity), caterer (with a 30-minute hold plan), a wheelchair-accessible coach with lift or ramp and securing points (not Coachline), and the band as a separable line item.

Coach inconsistency to flag: one coach for 140 guests does not fit, since a standard coach seats about 50-57. The coach company needs to quote suitable vehicle sizes or options. The second-coach trigger of more than 90 confirmed guests also needs reconciling with this capacity. Driver hours and curfew are to be checked if departure slips past 23:15.
Venue written confirmation needed for step-free access at drop-off, terrace, Orangery, Long Gallery, accessible toilets, accessible dinner seating, evacuation plan, and route to stage and top table.

Caterer written confirmation needed that there is no shellfish anywhere, including stocks and sauces, plus cross-contact controls. Menu to be supplied with allergen declarations for 18 vegetarian and 4 vegan guests.
Open questions for the client: keynote start time, top table guest list, named greeters, final guest and transport numbers, and whether the CEO should be listed as a VIP.
Rain decision is based on the forecast the day before (18 Nov); more than 40% moves the reception to the Long Gallery. Reception drinks are soft only until 20:30.
